objective: Provision and maintain AWS infrastructure, implement CI/CD pipelines, and ensure system scalability and reliability.
architecture: AWS cloud infrastructure including EKS cluster with EC2 nodes, PostgreSQL RDS, Redis cluster, S3 storage, networking, monitoring, and deployment pipelines.

techStack.rationale: Redis provides sub-millisecond response for session validation during clock-in operations. Redis Stack adds RediSearch for complex attendance pattern queries and rate limiting counters. Alternative: Memcached lacks persistence and search capabilities needed for audit trail caching. Limitation: Redis memory usage grows with 10,000 employee sessions, requiring careful eviction policies.

techStack.choice: AWS S3 with SSE-S3 encryption and lifecycle policies
techStack.rationale: S3 provides durable storage for facial verification images with automatic deletion via lifecycle policies. SSE-S3 encryption meets biometric data protection requirements without key management overhead. Alternative: Azure Blob Storage would tie us to Azure ecosystem when other components are AWS-based. Limitation: S3 eventual consistency requires careful handling of immediately deleted temp images.

techStack.choice: AWS EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service) with EC2-backed worker nodes
techStack.rationale: EKS provides Kubernetes orchestration for scaling microservices during peak clock-in periods. EC2-backed nodes eliminate Fargate cold starts, ensuring 3-second response SLA during global morning peaks. Regional pod placement ensures pods are active before timezone workday starts. Alternative: AWS Fargate would cause cold start delays breaching SLA during staggered timezone clock-ins. Limitation: EC2 nodes require more operational management than Fargate.

GitHub Actions integrates with Stark Digital's existing GitHub workflow. AWS CodeDeploy provides blue-green deployments for zero-downtime updates to attendance system. Alternative: Jenkins would require separate infrastructure management. Limitation: GitHub Actions concurrent job limits may slow parallel environment deployments.

securityDesign: Network security groups and VPC isolation
IAM role management with least privilege

Database schema definitions from Development team
